about.heading: # about
about.title: Web engineering
about.bio: I'm Brahyan Belalcázar, a Full-Stack developer with over 10 years shipping production software across sectors with very different business models: industrial mining and electricity (Tripro), tax and legal advisory (Restrepo y Londono), B2B and B2C e-commerce (Siesa Ecommerce), ERP and interactive signage (LogicalSoft), and publishing (Los Tres Editores). Each sector taught me different architectures, constraints, and engineering techniques — and that breadth is what lets me take complex features to full functionality. My core stack is JavaScript and PHP, mastered at senior level over the years: from custom WordPress plugins and REST APIs to complete Node.js architectures. Today I combine that track record with AI-assisted engineering to accelerate iterations without sacrificing quality.
about.philosophy: I believe in closing the loop: every feature goes through simulation, implementation, review, and testing — always under human control. The open source I publish (semantic memory, P2P mesh, multi-agent orchestration) is the lab where I validate those techniques:
about.philosophyAccent: iterate fast, verify always, ship to production.

xavier2.name: Xavier
xavier2.description: Persistent local cognitive memory core for AI agents built in Rust. Containerized Docker microservice providing vector storage, HNSW semantic search index, and unified knowledge graphs.
xavier2.architecture: Native Rust engine with SQLite-vec and pgvector. Cosine similarity vector search with local embeddings without external cloud dependency. High-speed REST and RPC APIs.
metrics: Unified integration with Hermes and Gestalt

timeline.label: Architectural design and vector persistence layer in Rust
Release v0.1 - CRUD operations, local embeddings, and REST endpoints
v0.6.0-beta - HNSW indices, Dockerization, and episodic memory
Roadmap: Semantic graph integration and context routing

gitcore.name: GitCore
gitcore.description: Operational harness and deterministic orchestrator for autonomous coding agents (Jules, Claude Code, OpenCode). Automates issue creation with formal specs, micro-fragmentation batches of up to 15 parallel tasks, and collision-free PR validation.
gitcore.architecture: Decoupled architecture in Rust and CLI automation scripts. Disjoint file islands system to prevent merge conflicts during massive parallel executions.

timeline.label: Initial issue protocol and agent traceability
Wave Operations: micro-fragmentation and 15 micro-task batches
Integration with Hermes Gateway and pre-delegation auditing
Roadmap: Multi-repository P2P distributed swarm

gestalt.name: Gestalt
gestalt.description: Autonomous swarm orchestrator and multi-role agent CLI routing in Rust. Uses SurrealDB for state persistence, role-based task routing, and custom inter-agent communication protocols.
gestalt.architecture: Native Rust CLI with Tokio async integration. Graph and state persistence in SurrealDB. Deterministic sandboxes for testing LLM-generated code.

timeline.label: Prototype and state schema in SurrealDB
Multi-agent coordination layer and dynamic execution from CLI
Continuous loop integration with Xavier memory
Roadmap: Decentralized swarm intelligence

photon-core.name: Photon-Core
photon-core.description: Authored university research and intellectual property serving as scientific foundation and roadmap for SouthWest AI Labs to experiment with future ultra-dense volumetric storage capabilities. Proof of concept (PoC) and simulation software in Rust modeling optical physics of femtosecond laser pulses in fused silica, Reed-Solomon ECC, birefringence, and 3D crosstalk mitigation.
photon-core.architecture: Deterministic Rust simulator modeling physical interaction between light and fused silica glass: optical slow-axis delay and optical axis orientation as 2 additional dimensions to spatial axes (X,Y,Z). Includes Rayon parallelism evaluating theoretical encoding rates >470 MB/s and interleaved Reed-Solomon ECC.
metrics: Mathematical simulation & PoC software authored by myself
3D spatial crosstalk tolerance >30% with Reed-Solomon ECC
Research foundation for SWAL's physical roadmap

researchLinks.source: University of Southampton Optoelectronics Research Centre

researchLinks.title: Project Silica: Storing data in glass for thousands of years with ultrafast laser
High-speed ultrafast laser 5D optical data storage in fused silica

timeline.label: Initial mathematical model and photonic voxel definition
Reed-Solomon ECC integration and 3D crosstalk simulation
Steganographic data hiding and CLI toolkit release
Roadmap: Deep learning-assisted signal reconstruction

edge-mesh.name: edge-mesh
edge-mesh.tagline: P2P Mesh Network with CRDT & Post-Quantum Crypto
edge-mesh.description: Peer-to-peer (P2P) communication network library featuring Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) and post-quantum cryptographic identity based on ML-DSA-65.
edge-mesh.architecture: Decentralized peer-to-peer topology without central server. Conflict-free replicated data types (Yjs/Automerge) for deterministic synchronization in hostile network conditions.

timeline.label: P2P discovery protocol design
CRDT scheme implementation and fork resolution
Adoption of post-quantum cryptographic standard ML-DSA-65
Roadmap: Mobile SDK for Android and iOS

orion.name: OrionHealth
orion.description: 100% offline-first personal health tracking and clinical metrics app. Encrypted local SQLite storage, background synchronization engine, and interactive analytical dashboard.
orion.architecture: Flutter & Dart with on-device encrypted SQLite database (SQLCipher). Resilient synchronization with offline data reconciliation and SSI privacy standards.

timeline.label: Clinical modeling and offline-first Flutter architecture
Encrypted persistence with SQLite and secure schemas
Background sync engine and analytics
Roadmap: P2P decentralized synchronization

gara-g.description: DePIN mobility network and vehicle mesh (V2V) with real-time telemetry, AI co-pilot, and decentralized marketplace for automotive sector.
gara-g.architecture: Rust backbone for automotive telemetry processing and Flutter mobile frontend. Vehicle mesh protocol for traffic alerts without cellular coverage.
